notes: DCD reports the July 2023 inauguration of an 18,000 sqm digital communications facility in the Oxagon industrial area of NEOM containing a high-capacity, highly efficient data center for 5G, satellite and fiber connectivity plus secure private cloud services projected to serve up to 60 locations and ~1,800 structures. Vendors include Huawei, STC Solutions, XFusion, Fortinet, NEC. Baxtel directory (C) lists ~12 MW for Tonomus/NEOM city as the largest Tabuk-market facility; official capacity not published.
